newsAll.head: Chuba Hubbard: Over 100 total yards in loss
newsAll.body: Hubbard rushed 19 times for 82 yards and brought in all four targets for 28 yards in the Panthers' 21-18 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

newsAll.head: Travis Etienne: Aggravates hamstring injury
newsAll.body: Etienne exited Sunday's 35-27 loss to the Raiders due to an injury to the same hamstring which bothered him in practice leading up to the game, head coach Kellen Moore revealed after the loss, John Hendrix of NewOrleans.

newsAll.head: Dalton Kincaid: Back down to earth Sunday
newsAll.body: Kincaid secured two of three targets for 38 yards and lost a fumble in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

newsAll.head: Justin Jefferson: Nearly came back in after hurting ankle
newsAll.body: Jefferson (ankle) "got close a couple times" to returning to Sunday's 23-16 win over the Buccaneers, head coach Kevin O'Connell said after the game, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

newsAll.head: Harold Fannin: Pair of TDs in win
newsAll.body: Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in the Browns' 21-18 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
